g.text: Serving tools: the agent call path
snapshot of each published tool pinned
to the job and artifact IDs it was
resolved by name at run time; never
stored in artifacts, evidence or logs
Results carry a run record: per-step status, the extracted output validated
against the output schema, the final URL. Failures carry a code an agent can
act on. After two consecutive site-change failures a tool is degraded and
refused with TOOL_UNAVAILABLE until an operator revalidates it; agents
never retry blindly against a changed site.
